+require "../spec_helper"
+
+describe Warp::IR do
+  it "builds and closes containers" do
+    bytes = "{}".to_slice
+    builder = Warp::IR::Builder.new(bytes, false, false, 4)
+    builder.start_object
+    builder.increment_count
+    builder.end_object
+    builder.start_array
+    builder.increment_count
+    builder.end_array
+    builder.empty_object
+    builder.empty_array
+    builder.tape.size.should be > 0
+  end
+
+  it "validates literals correctly" do
+    bytes = "true false null".to_slice
+    Warp::IR.valid_true?(bytes, 0, 4).should be_true
+    Warp::IR.valid_false?(bytes, 5, 5).should be_true
+    Warp::IR.valid_null?(bytes, 11, 4).should be_true
+  end
+
+  it "validates numbers correctly" do
+    bytes = "0 -1 3.14 1e2 1E+2 1E-2".to_slice
+    Warp::IR.valid_number?(bytes, 0, 1).should be_true
+    Warp::IR.valid_number?(bytes, 2, 2).should be_true
+    Warp::IR.valid_number?(bytes, 5, 4).should be_true
+    Warp::IR.valid_number?(bytes, 10, 3).should be_true
+    Warp::IR.valid_number?(bytes, 14, 4).should be_true
+    Warp::IR.valid_number?(bytes, 19, 4).should be_true
+    Warp::IR.valid_number?(bytes, 0, 0).should be_false
+  end
+
+  it "writes primitive entries for each type" do
+    bytes = "true false null 123".to_slice
+    builder = Warp::IR::Builder.new(bytes, true, true, 10)
+    builder.primitive(0, 4).should eq(Warp::ErrorCode::Success)
+    builder.primitive(5, 10).should eq(Warp::ErrorCode::Success)
+    builder.primitive(11, 15).should eq(Warp::ErrorCode::Success)
+    builder.primitive(16, bytes.size).should eq(Warp::ErrorCode::Success)
+  end
+
+  it "reports literal and number errors from primitives" do
+    bytes = "tru fals nul 01".to_slice
+    builder = Warp::IR::Builder.new(bytes, true, true, 10)
+    builder.primitive(0, 3).should eq(Warp::ErrorCode::TAtomError)
+    builder.primitive(4, 8).should eq(Warp::ErrorCode::FAtomError)
+    builder.primitive(9, 12).should eq(Warp::ErrorCode::NAtomError)
+    builder.primitive(13, bytes.size).should eq(Warp::ErrorCode::NumberError)
+  end
+
+  it "finds string and scalar ends" do
+    bytes = %({"a":"b","c":123}).to_slice
+    string_start = bytes.index('"'.ord, 0).not_nil!
+    next_struct = bytes.index(','.ord, string_start).not_nil!
+    end_idx = Warp::IR.scan_string_end(bytes, string_start + 1, next_struct)
+    bytes[end_idx].should eq('"'.ord)
+
+    number_start = bytes.index('1'.ord).not_nil!
+    next_struct = bytes.index('}'.ord, number_start).not_nil!
+    Warp::IR.scan_scalar_end(bytes, number_start, next_struct).should eq(next_struct)
+
+    closing_quote = bytes.index('"'.ord, string_start + 1).not_nil!
+    Warp::IR.scan_string_end(bytes, string_start + 1, closing_quote + 1).should eq(closing_quote)
+
+    whitespace_json = %({"a":42   }).to_slice
+    number_start = whitespace_json.index('4'.ord).not_nil!
+    next_struct = whitespace_json.index('}'.ord, number_start).not_nil!
+    Warp::IR.scan_scalar_end(whitespace_json, number_start, next_struct).should eq(whitespace_json.index(' '.ord, number_start).not_nil!)
+  end

+        quote = 0_u64

+        op = 0_u64
+        control = 0_u64

+              end
+            end

+            quote |= m.quote.to_u64 << shift
+            whitespace |= m.whitespace.to_u64 << shift
+            op |= m.op.to_u64 << shift
+            control |= m.control.to_u64 << shift
+            i += 16

+                 (scalar.op & 0xff_u16).to_u8 != m.op ||
+                 (scalar.control & 0xff_u16).to_u8 != m.control

+                  (scalar.quote & 0xff_u16).to_u8,
+                  (scalar.whitespace & 0xff_u16).to_u8,
+                  (scalar.op & 0xff_u16).to_u8,

+            whitespace |= m.whitespace.to_u64 << shift
+            op |= m.op.to_u64 << shift

+    #
+    # Allocates a buffer of file_size + 16, reads the file content into it and
+    # zeroes the trailing 16 bytes. Returns a pointer to the buffer (Pointer(UInt8))
+    # and the original file length as Int32. On error the function returns
+    # Pointer(UInt8).null and length 0.

+      seek_set = 0
+      seek_end = 2

+      if fd < 0
+        return {Pointer(UInt8).null, 0}
+      end

+      size = LibC.lseek(fd, 0, seek_end)
+      if size < 0
+        LibC.close(fd)
+        return {Pointer(UInt8).null, 0}
+      end
+      LibC.lseek(fd, 0, seek_set)

+        LibC.close(fd)
+        return {Pointer(UInt8).null, 0}
+      end

+          LibC.close(fd)
+          return {Pointer(UInt8).null, 0}
+        end

+      end

+
+        size = LibC.lseek(fd, 0, seek_end)

+          return Bytes.new(0)
